gates.reason: Inspected artifact-path handling, retained-byte validation, fixed command arguments, LLM prompt/context binding, and worktree path checks; the verifier performs no filesystem writes or process launches, does not transmit ~/.claude content, and rejects traversal in sealed untracked paths.

Inspected receipt digests, trusted identity anchors, lifecycle lineage, captured-stream lengths/digests, check-result derivation, retry authorization, classification reconstruction, and worktree evidence arithmetic; claims are rederived from retained artifacts with bounded, digest-verified provenance.

Inspected ingest and classification paths for unbounded artifact processing and repeated computation; individual and aggregate evidence sizes, captured streams, and untracked-file counts are bounded, with no release-gate performance defect identified.
